sup:70740.subject: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm peeled – proposal for the price basis from 2027
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for setting out the cost drivers behind it. We value our long-standing cooperation with Werdenfels and would like to agree a stable, transparent price basis for the coming period.

For reference, our purchase orders with you for this part on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

Your letter of 22 September proposed a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404, and we are glad to take that up. With a 45% material share, no deadband and base month August 2026, alloy movements would pass through to the price openly in both directions. The starting price would then no longer need to allow for future material risk. We would combine this with a 36-month commitment at 23,700 kg per year instead of 12 months, which gives you planning certainty over a longer period. Because the index clause and the longer term cover these risks, we ask you to review the starting price.

Our proposal:
- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- As per our enquiry: DAP, 14 days lead time, effective 1 January 2027, no tooling

Would this package work for you? If any element does not suit you, please let us know which one and what you could offer instead, so we can find a workable basis together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm peeled – proposal for the price basis from 2027
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we appreciate your proposal to establish a stable price basis with a 36-month contract and an index clause. 

We can offer a revised starting price of EUR 5.40/kg under these new terms, reflecting the shared risk and extended commitment. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

To summarize our Angebot, we present a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Part 370010 – starting price on your 30-day and 90-day structures
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for the step you made on both structures. We are glad that we now share the same framework: 36 months, AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08, and the fixed terms of our enquiry.

The remaining gap is the starting price, and the alloy component deserves a closer look. AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent movement sits alongside the annual increase you described. The agreed index clause will share alloy movements with you from the base month onwards in both directions. We therefore believe the starting price can reflect where the alloy market stands today rather than carry additional material risk.

On the two structures you priced, we propose:

Option 1: EUR 4.98/kg, payment 30 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08.
Option 2: EUR 5.05/kg, payment 90 days net, 36 months, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08.

Each price applies only together with its own payment term, clause and contract term. The fixed terms remain as in our enquiry: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, effective 1 January 2027, no tooling.

Could you confirm whichever option you can approve as your binding offer? If neither works, please let us know which term stands in the way, and we will gladly look at it together with you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot is valid for 7 days.

Our current offer is a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

As an alternative, as a result, we are pleased to offer a revised starting price of EUR 5.10 per kg for the 30-day payment structure.
